Instructions & options

View kit on Seeed Studio ↗ (opens in a new tab)

The circles are enlarged views of the indicated connectors, not additional parts.

  1. Parts

    Check the four parts: the narrow LoRa antenna marked 868 MHz, the Wio-SX1262 board, the broad Wi-Fi antenna marked 2.4 GHz, and the XIAO ESP32S3 board.

  2. Connect Wi-Fi

    Align the broad 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi antenna plug with the antenna socket on XIAO. Press straight down until seated. The circular close-up shows this same connection.

  3. Connect LoRa

    Align the narrow 868 MHz LoRa antenna plug with the antenna socket on Wio. Press straight down until seated. The circular close-up shows this same connection.

  4. Join the boards

    Turn the boards to show the rear connector. Position Wio above XIAO, align the small board-to-board connector, then press straight down. Keep both antenna cables outside the board gap. The XIAO socket is shown simplified in the close-up.

  5. Assembled

    Both antennas are connected and the boards are joined. Turn the assembly back to the front, as shown at the end of the animation.
